## What changed?

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] Algorithm changes include a deterministic regression case.
- [ ] Algorithm changes include a relevant hard negative.
- [ ] New images or datasets have explicit redistribution rights and a `source_group_id`.
- [ ] Confidence evidence is independent rather than duplicated from a correlated branch.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] `pytest` and `ruff check .` pass locally.
- [ ] Public API, status, schema or config changes update the specification and changelog.
- [ ] Runtime or memory-sensitive changes include a proportional benchmark or smoke test.
- [ ] No private images, secrets, local paths, build environments or generated caches are included.

Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting instead of a pull request for security-sensitive
details.
